messages:
ivy: Short follow-up from today's all-hands -- collecting leadership answers to a few top questions so we can publish a small FAQ.

ivy: Q1) What's one sentence we can put in a brochure that captures why Redwood exists?

noah: "To make LLM inference predictable and cost-effective so teams can ship features without surprise ops or latency regressions." Keep it customer-benefit focused.

ivy: Q2) For sales: what's the tightest contrast vs big cloud AI endpoints?

noah: Cloud endpoints = model access. Redwood = production controls + observability + rollout safety. Engineers get explicit levers to tune cost/latency (batching, cache, quantization) and rollback if quality drops.

ivy: Q3) Messaging: should we start with "build vs buy" or "managed inference"?

sanjay: Start with "build vs buy" for technical audiences. For broader materials say "managed inference that preserves control" so it doesn't sound like a black box.

ivy: Q4) Competitor comparisons: high-level or explicit?

sanjay: High-level in public content. Maintain a gated appendix with direct TCO and latency numbers against cloud providers and prominent open runtimes for sales/SEs.

faye: Also call out a different axis: self-hosted runtimes often lack rollout policies and integrated fallback routing which causes risk during peak/maintenance windows. That's a practical reliability story.

ivy: Q5) What single deliverable this quarter best shows execution on strategy?

noah: The persona playbook + the customer-run benchmark harness. If we can hand prospects a short playbook and a runnable benchmark with anonymized results, conversion will improve.

ivy: Practical ask: can we publish a 600-word FAQ summarizing these answers?

sanjay: Yes. Keep it concrete, include one anonymized benchmark and a short TCO example. Marketing + legal will scrub.

ops-bot: All-hands slides and recording uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/all-hands/3609876543

ivy: Great, assigning owners: @noah to draft FAQ, @sanjay to assemble appendix, @faye to get benchmark blurb. Closing thread after follow-ups. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
